notes.title: Starting Loadouts & Scoring Revamp! - Patch 0.2.7 now Live
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!

Big update today as we head towards The Witch. Originally, she was going to be released alongside this update, but due to the importance of the changes contained here we wanted to separate them out for now.[/p][p]To get straight into it, let's start with the two big features![/p][h2]Starting Loadouts[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447148/3ab0763590979ce4c8a92e324a15a906bdbda6f2.png"][/img][/p][p]One of the most common requests we've got since Day 1 is wanting more control over the start of your runs. We agree! We've just added the first Subclasses for each character into the game, which you will unlock naturally as you discover more Relics. These Subclasses are designed to not only give you a boost, but also provide you with a starting framework to put a build together![/p][h2]Scoring Changes[/h2][p]This is probably the biggest change we've made to the game since it's debut in Early Access. Previously, the scoring of Hands worked off of a multiplier based system. This was good to begin with, but as we introduced more challenging content, the scale of numbers became difficult to keep up with. We've rewritten the base scoring into a hand-value based system. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447148/66949ae55548a21085cff8045113a2e8eacdbd8f.png"][/img][/p][p]The key goals here was to reduce the likelihood of huge "one hit knockout" Turns (which Death is somewhat fond of pulling off with his Crown...) as well as shrink the gap between low face value and high face value hands. Previously, a Pair of 1s was worth 4, and a Pair of 6s was worth 24. While face values should matter, the difference was far too great and actively punished the player for opting for a low-face reliant strategy. In the new system, the gap is greatly diminished, while still remaining to a degree in order to make face values still matter.[/p][p]Want to get to grips with it yourself? [b]You can now hover the score of Hands for a breakdown of their scoring![/b][/p][h2]Scoring Based Relic Changes[/h2][p]The scoring rework above mandated that some relics had to change, as previously "Pre-Multiplier" was a thing and now it's not. You'll see moderate changes to relics like Torn Banner, Pomander, Bannerman's and the like to account for this.[/p][h2]Relic Balance Changes[/h2][p]Asides from the scoring mandated balancing, we've updated a few Relics to bring them more in line with the rest of the game:[/p][list][*][p]Artisan's Hammer now "breaks" after forging 3 total Relics. It keeps it's beneficial effect to Bronze Pickaxe, but will no longer spawn more Relics.[/p][/*][*][p]Alpha Dice's summoned Omega Dice now disappears after the Roll, prior to Banking. It's no secret Alpha Dice was by far and away the strongest Relic in the game due to it's "free dice" effect of Omega Dice. This way it keeps the explosive Reinforce 6 chance, but no longer simply provides a 7th Dice.[/p][/*][*][p]Two Rabbit's Paws has been reworked to now apply Vulnerable and a Random Curse (Curses?!?! what are these...) to your Opponent.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][p]Thanks for your continued help in bug hunting as we walk the path to 1.0! Here's some of the more impactful player facing bugs squashed in this update:[/p][list][*][p]Hollow Hand will no longer prefer non-Base Dice.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a few cases that could result in Mirror of Meeral not correctly reflecting Damage to Death from his Relics[/p][/*][*][p]Relic Dice that you replace will now correctly be removed from your current Dice icons[/p][/*][*][p]Golden Shackle will no longer lie to you about breaking the shackle when you Basilisk & Bank it.[/p][/*][*][p]Executioner's Dice will now alert you that it can be activated when the health threshold is met.[/p][/*][*][p]We've improved the relic printout flow for several Relics, although work on this is ongoing![/p][/*][/list][p]That's the key points for this update, which is a big one! As always thanks so much for your support & help in making the game the best we can.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]Connagh & Joel[/p][p]Sea Glass Games[/p]

notes.title: 8 New Dice, Buffs, QoL & Reworks - Patch 0.2.6b Now Live!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!

Quite a big update for you all this week. Thanks so much for the reviews, feedback and bug reports as always. Let's just dive straight into the details as this is the kind of update you should go play rather than read about.[/p][h2]8 New Dice![/h2][p]Eight new Dice have been added to the game (and we've fixed the bug that stopped a few previous new ones showing up for you...). These range in effect from offensive options, synergies and defensive. I don't want to spoilt them all as they each come with a conversation with Death, but as a tease, fumblers rejoice! [b]The Bumbler[/b] has joined the fray.[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447148/e6927574b082ffd7e8b3f6ee22aace934c963c9b.png"][/img][/h2][h2]Relic Buffs & Reworks[/h2][p]In this update you'll also find some changes to existing Relics - some to make them more appealing, and some to open design space for the future. I'll explain the ones that have made it into this patch.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447148/e4f9f908d9057bf95ca8642c26fe8c2c58fdf036.png"][/img]Nautilus Anchor had fallen behind the general power curve of the game, and the methodology of stacking it up in a safer round earlier was somewhat tedious. Now, Anchor not only has a more appealing countermeasure element by growing in strength the larger values you fumble, but it also allows people wanting to build around it to speed up some of the more tedious play patterns of stacking it up.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447148/8d23fdcaffbadcd8b3724d99e924255665b0d523.png"][/img]Ivory Pawn was always intended to make the self-poisoning downsides of some Relics more manageable, as well as defend against any Poison that Death may utilise. Simply put, it was too weak in this aspect to justify picking. We've reworked it to now fully prevent Poison being applied for the first 150 stacks, while still dealing them as damage to Death if matched up with a Rook.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447148/6fd2e1466dd833e653a49867a578cd25d68f9193.png"][/img]Probably the most controversial Relic in the game (except the ongoing debate of if Hollow Hand is absolutely terrible or OP) - Runaway's Purse has been changed to take away it's Trinket respawning capabilities. We've replaced it with a buff to Wisp lanterns to make it a more appealing pair with Writing Lily or just for people who love seeing 18 Dice in the bowl.[/p][p][/p][p]I know some people may be disappointed to see Purse change, but the most honest explanation is while Purse had it's Trinket spawning effect, it essentially prevented us from adding any other Trinket spawning or Trinket buffing effects to the game, because with Purse in it's old form, it was so powerful that Trinkets were on a constant knife edge when it came to balance. This way, it remains a solid Trinket engine without dominating the design space.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447148/70dc00d0bd36a572a388a5f336bb717b44c8f9e8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447148/0a10a6c336e0efa6f95a1bd78dceb747fbcbd35a.png"][/img]These two are listed together - now at a glance, you may think "but Pickaxe hasn't changed!". It has.
Pickaxe is deliberately vague about what it can dig up, but it no longer has access to digging up Relics. Instead, we've shifted Relic generation to Artisan's Hammer, bringing back some of that Forge-flavour to a more controllable form and giving it a purpose outside of Pickaxe stacks. As for Pickaxe it has lost Relic generation but a good chunk of that has been shifted over to the chances to unearth Dice, so it's not all downside for the miners out there.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447148/b2181fe35921df33811b7d80efeb09e23c604922.png"][/img][/p][p]Pauper's Cup has also changed to 50 stacks from 75. 75 was too much. That's the explanation.[/p][h2]Quality of Life & Other Stuff[/h2][p][/p][p]Some pretty nice upgrades to QoL & Bug Fixes in this update:[/p][list][*][p]Game Speed will now save between play sessions meaning you no longer have to toggle your preference upon playing again[/p][/*][*][p]Several tooltips that weren't despawning correctly in some cases should no longer remain on screen[/p][/*][*][p]Bugs that were causing some newer Dice to not populate into choices for some players should be resolved[/p][/*][*][p]Some tooltip inaccuracies & lack of clarity cases have been corrected[/p][/*][*][p]Several minor texture fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Rest are largely backend bugs or fixes to niche technical issues.[/p][/*][/list][p]Those are the feature updates for this week! Thanks for playing and let us know how you find the new Dice on the discussions page!

Cheers,[/p][p][/p][p]Connagh & Joel[/p][p][/p][p]Sea Glass[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: New Dice, Health Buffs & Item Reworks! - Patch 0.2.6a now Live!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]First part of another Patch here, we wanted to hustle to get this out for you all to beat up over the weekend.[/p][p]There's a lot more Dice coming (this is a small portion of the batch) - as well some other improvements. But let's get into the details as this is largely a content focused update.[/p][h2]New Dice[/h2][p]A handful of new Dice can be found in game! These are base unlocks, whereas the rest of this set will be arriving alongside new conversations with Death in order to unlock them. Head in game now to experiment with the [b]Open Wounds, Best Friend, As The Crow Flies, Safety Net and The Old Ways Dice![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447148/2456512ec66c5cebae4d8279cd153f2d95532926.png"][/img][/p][h2]Base Health Update[/h2][p]One of the core issues we've seen is players feeling the need to pull off perfect turns or builds as they can't risk taking a hit from Death on higher difficulties. Obviously while we all want to go off every turn, sometimes the option should be there to take the safe Pass and tank a hit or two. To aid players having more options when it comes to this, we've significantly increased the Bonus Health given by Relics across the game, and the player should have a much better pool with which to soak up the hits.[/p][h2]Item Reworks[/h2][p]We all know Heart Locket can get a little out of hand, it's also a little dull in our opinion. We've redesigned it to keep the Healing-Machine Gun effect but without it's limitless scaling. However, to counteract this, we have given it a new unique effect - it now serves as a second chance, shattering on your loss to resurrect you. Best part is once it breaks? You can find another one.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447148/db806ec86604bc9f56476988d6687a124593d533.png"][/img]
The other Relic that should be no big surprise was in our sights this week after the Buffening was Pauper's Cup. Who would have thought healing 300 health a turn was a little OP? Anyway, we've set a cap (but still a pretty high one... it's not escaping the watchlist yet) as well as a fun bonus for reaching said cap, rewarding some valuable Rerolls.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447148/e7b7958606c64b7a52548139e3571329151defe8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447148/fd549e3c64c917a9d8cfef935abd05aba455ab97.png"][/img][/p][p]This really is Part 1 of the bigger update landing next week. So we'll see you then with many new Dice and tricks in hand! 

Cheers,[/p][p][/p][p]Connagh & Joel[/p][p][/p][p]Sea Glass[/p]

notes.title: Balancing Patch now Live
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!

In the recent Patch 0.2.5, we finally updated a lot of Relics that had fallen behind the times. The results from this have largely been very positive, however it did have an anticipated side effect of making a select few relics that were already lifelines for successful runs into an absolutely monstrous state in terms of overperformance. 

This patch tones some of these down to give other Relics a chance for parity, and to reduce the emphasis on trying to go "infinite" which restricted appealing options. We've also buffed Hollow Hand a bit, because why not.[/p][p]Full Changes:
[/p][list][*][p]Hollow Hand now only requires 5 Stacks to transform, and it's scoring boost has been increased from 25% to 42%[/p][/*][*][p]Glimmal Ring has been changed to Reinforce 1 if you have 4 or less Dice, and Reinforce 2 if you have 1 or less Dice.[/p][/*][*][p]Sapphire Ring now requires 100 stacks, up from 50.[/p][/*][*][p]Cassandra's Tongue now applies 12 Poison to Death, and 6 Poison to self.[/p][/*][*][p]Runaway's Purse now gives a 40% chance to create a new Trinket.[/p][/*][*][p]Treasure Cube now has standardised 1 through 6 faces, rather than only 1s and 6s. However, it's chance for you to be Lucky on a 1 has been increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Alpha Dice & Omega Dice now have standardised 1 through 6 faces, we kept it's explosive 6 Reinforcement, but now it happens in a much less reliable fashion.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We also fixed a bug some players were experiencing regarding Envenomed Blade's poison stacks, as well as a Heart Locket blocking Poison damage issue, alongside a few other minor corrections. There is still an issue causing Heart Locket to block poison that we are correcting currently however.[/p][p][/p][p]As an additional note - for users on below min-spec machines who are experiencing vram related "fatal errors" or similar, please try forcing DX11 and Low by placing "-dx11 -low" without the quotation marks in your launch options found in the properties of the game on Steam. This could help resolve those issues.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p][/p][p]Connagh & Joel[/p][p]
Sea Glass[/p]

notes.title: New Difficulty Level & Basilisk Statuette Rework! - Patch 0.2.5b Live!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!

We're back with the second part of yesterday's patch that needed a little more testing. To keep it brief, we've added the next Circle difficulty level, and reworked Basilisk Statuette to make it a little less easy to dominate with.[/p][h2]Circle 4 - Death's Ring Box[/h2][p]The new difficulty level is the first where we gave Death a thematic set of relics (including a new one!). In this one, you'll battle against Death as he rummages through his Ring Box, gaining Gemstone Ring relics as your run progresses.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447148/e00e80056d4cc4cb63b995eb0f9eca078df9b763.png"][/img]He also brings his new Ring to the table that gives a sneak peek at one of the spells coming with the Witch! As rounds progress, his Curse becomes more and more likely to eat one of your Dice for a Turn. Don't worry, he gives it back, just hope it doesn't happen at too crucial a moment...[/p][h2]Basilisk Statuette Rework[/h2][p]We all love locking Dice of Many Faces with Basilisk Statuette infinitely, but we also probably shouldn't be doing that. We've made a change to everyones favourite snake statue to limit it to locking each Dice once per Turn. It's still plenty powerful and can repeat combos, just not ad infinitum now.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447148/d992f5336eee94e6066eb3d3f4bd7390c7236956.png"][/img][/p][p]Asides from other bug fixes & minor tweaks, that's it for the second half of 0.2.5b!

Let us know how you find the new challenge! Death will have further themes in the future, and the Rings set is just the beginning.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p][/p][p]Connagh & Joel[/p]

notes.title: The Buffening, Death's Mercy & Forge Reworked - Patch 0.2.5 Live!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!

First off, welcome to all the new players! We've recently seen a huge influx and all of your kind words, feedback and support has been just unbelievable beyond words really, so thank you.[/p][p]We're still fairly early on in Early Access, so naturally we're experimenting a lot as we develop future content in the best way we can. Because of this, some Relics had fallen behind the performance players coming into the game expect of them, and equally some of the experimental features we had given Death were missing the mark in terms of being the most fun possible.[/p][p]This patch takes aim solely at those issues. We took a brief break from The Witch to work on revitalising some of the outdated Relic arsenal. Here's the full details.[/p][h2]Death's Mercy Rework[/h2][p]One of the most common bits of feedback that we have got is that the current iteration of Death's Mercy simply isn't fun. The good news is, behind the scenes we were already discussing this and potential options.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447148/80def5d612bb1531f60ea05733758624a3e2f461.png"][/img]In it's old form, rendering Death invulnerable for a turn was anti-climactic and often robbed players of a close game with no real "fun" reasoning. So we've reworked it. It'll still give Death a bit of staying power if you don't quite finish him off, but in a much more manageable fashion.[/p][h2]Death's Forge[/h2][p]We knew from Day 1 that we want Death to evolve as a threat in multiple ways as a run goes on. The Forge was a means of achieving that. Not too long ago, we added the ability for it to create Relics for him to use as an experiment. While it could introduce some good variance, it could also introduce some... bad variance, to be blunt. Additionally, it limited our design space on Relics as they either had to be not too ridiculous for Death to forge, or unavailable to him.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447148/3a3b6c16cf9645ad8e872268dd4e5f6199c5382c.png"][/img]We've removed the Relic generation from Forge. The Dice upgrading remains as it is a means of a growing threat that feels more fitting for him, and still rewards the player for beating him before it goes off if possible in a round or two, while having a much less dooming impact if they don't.[/p][h2]Many, many Buffs...[/h2][p]Now we get to the real meat and potatoes of the Patch. The absolute top question asked has been "Why is this relic so good, but these ones are so bad". The answer is yes. Or no. Or this is the answer. Anyway, with so many players coming into the game, we used a bunch of that data to bring a lot of Relics way way up to speed. This is Early Access and some of these changes are experimental! But go have fun breaking them in new ways.[/p][p]Full List of Buffs:
[/p][list][*][p]Arrowhead now heals 10 per Reinforcement instead of 5.[/p][/*][*][p]Artist's Paint Brush only gains 1x the Face Value, but now doesn't lose counters between Rounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Black Pebble's Damage & Healing has been increased to 34 from 25.[/p][/*][*][p]White Pebble's Damage & Healing has been increased to 35 from 25.[/p][/*][*][p]Canary Pendant is now a Common so you can easier find Damage Negation if you need it.[/p][/*][*][p]Cassandra's Tongue Poison increased from 10 to 15, and now inflicts self with 5 Poison instead of dealing 10 Damage to self.[/p][/*][*][p]Catalytic Vial has been reworked to now gain a Counter if you successfully deal banked Damage on your first Turn, then add 20 Poison to your Opponent for each Counter. It does not lose Counters between Rounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Coral Ring Poison increased from 5 to 6.[/p][/*][*][p]Diamond Ring Healing increased from 20 to 30[/p][/*][*][p]Emerald Ring Poison increased from 20 to 25[/p][/*][*][p]Envenomed Blade now increases Poison stacks by 50% up from 33%[/p][/*][*][p]Fools Gold now also restores a Relic Reroll to use in between rounds, in addition to the bonus Dice.[/p][/*][*][p]Mirror of Meeral now deals Damage equal to that which was Negated, instead of a flat 10.[/p][/*][*][p]Paupers Cup no longer loses Counters between Rounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Pomander bonus increased to 15 from 12.[/p][/*][*][p]Poultice now both Heals and Poisons for the highest face value.[/p][/*][*][p]Ruby Ring Damage increased from 20 to 30.[/p][/*][*][p]Runaway's Purse now also creates a Healing Flask if you start a Round with no Trinkets.[/p][/*][*][p]Torn Banner bonus increased from 6 to 7.[/p][/*][*][p]Ivory Pawn now removes 50% of Poison up from 33%.[/p][/*][*][p]Writing Lily now deals 15 Damage to self down from 20.[/p][/*][*][p]Midas Dice now increases Scored Hands by 100% up from 50%.[/p][/*][*][p]Razor's Edge now deals double Face Value as Damage up from 1x.[/p][/*][*][p]Draupnir now adds stacks to rings equal to double Face Value up from 2x.[/p][/*][*][p]Bannerman's Dice now boosts all other Dice by 1 + Face Value up from Face Value.[/p][/*][/list][p]
As you can see, we buffed quite a lot of older Relics! The intention here is to open up more viable builds into the early higher difficulty levels of Circles 2 and 3. If this seems excessive, just imagine the harder modes we're cooking up beyond Circle 3.[/p][p]Anyway we need to get back to working on The Witch! Have fun and once again thanks so much for the support in the recent days. We are a two man team and couldn't do this without you.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p][/p][p]Connagh & Joel[/p][p]
Sea Glass[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix Live - Immunity Bugs, 150% Speed & Settings!
notes.content:
[p]A hotfix is now live addressing some of the bugs caused in our end-of-turn refactoring as we prepare for The Witch.[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that could soft lock the game if you managed to bypass Death's Mercy through a few niche ways[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that could result in Death being even more unfair and stealing two dice with Death's Void[/p][/*][*][p]Settings will now display your currently chosen toggles from those available[/p][/*][*][p]We had a few requests asking for "faster but not that fast", so we have added a new 1.5x Speed mode for those looking for something between 1x and 2x.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Deck will now correctly always display button prompts (did you know you can use X/Y and R1 to Roll/Pass/Bank? No? This bug is probably why!)[/p][/*][/list][p]There's a few other minor fixes in the background related to mechanics but nothing worth mentioning. The next big update will be the new character!

Thanks for playing as always,[/p][p]Sea Glass[/p]

notes.title: Healer Buff, New Tooltips & Bug Fixes! - Patch 0.2.4 Live
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,

Relatively small update today, mostly taking care of a few issues and implementing a lot of work to prepare for the arrival of our third playable character, The Witch! This update is largely comprised of background work (hover the stake in the graveyard...) but there's still some good stuff.[/p][h2]Healer's Cauldron Buff[/h2][p]The Healer has been performing pretty well in runs, but it's a little too easy to fall behind early on her at the moment. To help her out, we've increased the strength of her first couple of turns building up the Cauldron by 10-20% across the board. Simply put, the Cauldron should feel a lot better now even if you use it quickly. We've really souped it up, it's soup now. There's soup in the cauldron.[/p][h2]New Status Tooltips[/h2][p]We all loved the default windows text tooltips that were in place for hovering over status effects. However, we've replaced them with some rather snazzier ones. We've also reduced the size of trinkets as you can see in the image below a little, just to allow for more space on the board (as the Witch might be needing some of that...)[/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447148/0d9c84ad7050dd6b929435e16257528a29e65674.png"][/img]Bug Fixes[/h2][p]Whole host of bug fixes as per usual, including:

- VFX on Fishtail Rook & Nautilus Anchor made slightly less terrible.[/p][p]- Controller highlight of Dice won't always snap on regardless of controller use or not.[/p][p]- Clickable area on Cauldron updated to be less fiddly and some VFX polishes implemented (it's also bigger now too)[/p][p][/p][p]That's all for now! See you soon for the Witch! 

Cheers,

Sea Glass[/p]

Sea Glass[/p]

notes.title: Re-Rolls & New Item Classes! - Patch 0.2.3 now Live!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!

Very excited to bring this patch to you all. This week, we're introducing one of the most requested features since Day 1 of Early Access - Re-Rolls! [/p][h2]Rerolling Relics[/h2][p]You can now Re-Roll your available Relic or Dice choices to try your luck once more at building out the strategy you're aiming for.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447148/89d6e603ed1aa92f170e045f78adbc592a915279.png"][/img][/p][p]We experimented with a lot of different forms for the Re-Rolls - Health Costs, Relic Costs, unlimited, etc. We landed on one we think really brings another decision and strategy layer to the game. You have 3 to use whenever you please, but be careful, they don't restock! Perhaps there will be ways to replenish your Re-Roll chances in the future... but for now, it's a sacred resource![/p][p][/p][h2]Less Class Restrictions[/h2][p]We wanted to pair this with another change we've listened to and agree with. When Dice With Death was in it's most nascent stages, we designed it with the idea that most characters would largely use their own pool of Relics and Dice. [/p][p]
This restriction lessened over time as the game took on it's true identity, and it's time to finally cast off the remains of the original design. This is experimental, and there will still be the occasional Relic or Dice limited to certain Characters, but for now - [b]far more Relics are available to any character, instead of being locked to one. [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447148/a55b8c0d16420ab0cb1219112e3a79c7e787a3b1.png"][/img][/p][p]Glimmal Ring on the Healer or Sanguine Dice & Pomander on the Soldier to go with your Heart Locket? Go for it![/p][p][/p][p]This was the last major feature we were aiming for prior to the release of our third playable character, The Witch. She plays a way that is incomparable to our current two characters, so is a lot of work! We're aiming to have her playable within the month, so watch this space. I think you'll all really enjoy her as well as some of the wild designs coming up for future classes. Believe me when we say the Healer & the Soldier are simply the baseline.[/p][p][/p][p]Only two balance changes this time - just updating existing Dice to better reflect their power intent:
[/p][list][*][p]Sanguine Dice is now a Common[/p][/*][*][p]Dice of Many Faces is now a Legendary[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for all of your support, as always your bug reports & reviews are invaluable to us.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p][/p][p]Connagh & Joel[/p][p]Sea Glass[/p]

notes.title: Steam Deck Controls Hotfix
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Just a Steam Deck specific update here - our official layout now correctly uses clickable trackpads to emulate mouse input, meaning the entire game can be played with just the right trackpad.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p][/p][p]Sea Glass[/p]

notes.title: Bug Fixes Galore! - Patch 0.2.2 Live
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!

First off, thank you so much for the incredible support in the Steam Summer Sale. We smashed our target for the entire sale by the end of Day 2, so yeah. It's been amazing! Thank you to everyone who has left us reviews and reported bugs especially, we couldn't do it without you.[/p][p]This week is a quieter patch but a good one in terms of bugs & stability. We're heads down working on two big features, and before we really dug in on those we wanted to take some time to stamp out as many bugs as we could.[/p][p]As a reminder, the next two larger content updates will be the Re-Roll System and the third playable character, The Witch. Re-Rolls will be first, and should add an excellent decision layer and more agency to your runs.[/p][p]As for 0.2.2, here's the headline bugs we fixed. There's other boring minor technical corrections too, but the gameplay impacts are as follows:[/p][olist][*][p]Hollow Hand should no longer appear for selection after Sated Hand has already been transformed. [/p][/*][*][p]Catalytic Vial has received an updated tooltip to bring it more in line with player expectations and the games developed format.[/p][/*][*][p]The Healer should now correctly unlock if you beat both Round 4 and Death for the first time in the same run![/p][/*][*][p]We finally chased down one of the causes of the mysterious "missing Herbal Remedy / Other base Relics" and these should consistently appear in your collections now.[/p][/*][*][p]Death has figured out which way round to hold the Nautilus Anchor and will no longer mistakenly lose his stacks on it between rounds.[/p][/*][*][p]If you manage to gain Artisan's Hammer before a Pickaxe, it will no longer rack up swings for the Pickaxe in the background![/p][/*][/olist][p]We're also hard at work on making the game work on even older hardware with integrated graphic chips. While this is always a challenge, we just wanted to state that it is on the list and usually when Connagh has a day he doesn't feel like smashing his head into The Witch's Relic designs, he chips away on that. So an even more "barebones" (get it) low detail mode will be coming in the near future there.

Once again thank you for all the help, and we can't wait to bring Re-Rolls to the game soon!

Cheers,[/p][p]
Connagh & Joel
Sea Glass Games[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - Ea Nasir's Ingot
notes.content:
EA Nasir's Ingot 
- Corrected "Hand Bonus" list in the backend, should now correctly apply bonuses to all hands.

notes.title: New Relics & More! - Patch 0.2.1 Live
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!

First off a small request - if you haven't already, please take a few seconds to leave us a Steam review. As a small indie team it helps out more than you can imagine with getting the game in front of people![/p][p]This patch sees us introduce two new Relics, the Hollow Hand and Ivory Pawn.[/p][h2]Hollow Hand (& Sated Hand)[/h2][p]We've implemented the first of our relics that transform. This will be a recurring mechanic and we're excited to add the first one to Early Access. These relics represent powerful upgrade paths, or even a price to be paid, in order to access their late stages. You'll see ones with multiple stages in the future, but for now, meet the Hollow Hand.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447148/764424890d7489b1c7a6165cbaee1784c2f8fb48.png"][/img][/p][p]Can you feed the Hands insatiable hunger for Dice and survive? If so you'll be rewarded with it transforming into the Sated Hand![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447148/6b20c2028f0a2bb25eb2074b08d4c7a5906d43cd.png"][/img]Why would someone gift Death their severed hand? Stop asking questions.[/p][h2]Ivory Pawn[/h2][p]The other Relic joining the game this patch is the Ivory Pawn! This helpful little fella will stop Death obliterating your life totals with Poison stacks, and if you pair it with a certain Rook, it will even turn it against him, dealing damage.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447148/a4aa90050f82ba89972432978f044919e8d00e9d.png"][/img][/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][p]A lot of minor fixes have made their way in. A few highlights include that your chosen speed option will persist between runs, no longer needing to be set every time you return to main menu! (You'll still have to toggle double speed when starting a run once).[/p][p]We also fixed a couple of tech debt issues regarding people who bought the game prior to cloud saves being enabled sometimes not getting their correct saves on Steam Deck. This should also address some resolution reset issues.[/p][p]Other than that the bug fixes were sadly quite boring this time, lots of scale fixes on minor assets and backend stuff.[/p]

notes.title: New Difficulty Levels & More! - Patch 0.2.0 now Live.
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!

Today we put live what is most likely the biggest update of Early Access so far! If you've been waiting for a moment to hop back in and try the changes that we've introduced through the first month and a bit, this is a good one![/p][p]Of course this is an update with a lot of moving parts and balancing, so we appreciate all of your help in testing it. Don't worry if things seem wonky at first - there'll be tweaks to come.[/p][h2]
New Difficulties - 2nd & 3rd Circle added[/h2][p]We've added the first two difficulties above the base game! As you may guess from their names, there's a lot more to come. [/p][p]These difficulties come with a variety of challenges introduced to intensify your game against Death. There's also a couple of boons for the player too though - but be warned, these will prove a challenge!

We'll let you find out for yourself what changes as you unlock them, to do so you need to defeat Death in the prior level (defeating the base difficulty will unlock 2nd Circle mode)[/p][p][/p][h2]Healer Cauldron Revamp[/h2][p]The Healer's Cauldron went live in it's most basic form that was left over from the Alpha of the game. Today she gets her true cauldron! Now, it will properly reward you for investing in it over multiple turns by upgrading the tiers of ingredients she has inside. It also now has access to it's first rare ingredients that can prevent you taking damage or even stop you fumbling! There's more to come in this regard, but for now there's actually a reward in building it up before use.[/p][h2]Relic Changes[/h2][p]We've made a few changes to Relics just to improve game flow and strategies when picking round by round. [/p][list][*][p]Envenomed Blade has been reworked slightly - it is now a Common, and provides a 33% increase to all Poison applied to Death by the Player. However, it will Poison you for 8 each turn! Better stock up on those Herbal Remedies...[/p][/*][*][p]Hunt Trophies & Last Stand are now Rare - These are relics that make more sense once you've picked up a few things to work with them. To make that smoother for newer players, they're now Rare[/p][/*][*][p]Emerald Ring is now Common - Way back when, Emerald Ring was one of the strongest relics in the pre-Alpha. It's rarity reflected this. But we live in a new world with Blasting Charges and Pickaxes flying everywhere, so we've made Emerald Ring a common to help Poison strategies get off the ground a little easier[/p][/*][/list][p]Naturally with an update of this size, there's a tonne of bug fixes and minor tweaks on the backend. Please keep up the active bug reporting and jump in the Discord to chat with us if you haven't! You'll find a link on the main Steam Page or pinned on the Community Forum.[/p][p][/p][p]Good luck & have fun in the new difficulties!

Sea Glass[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix: Achievements, Game Summary, and Relics
notes.content:
[b]Summary[/b]
In our effort to get Steam Achievements to you all as quickly as possible we hit some snags!
Achievements were not properly being reported/recorded from the game through to Steam, this should now be resolved and Steam API is being pinged more often.

There were some issues in the Game Summary page that have now been resolved, reported numbers should now be more accurate. 

[b]Relic Updates[/b]
[i]Bronze Pickaxe[/i]
A Pickaxe more Steel than Bronze
- We know, it's strong! 
We'd like to test some numbers with Bronze Pickaxe being upgraded from a Common to a Rare Relic. This means it may appear less often, or later in your runs, but we feel that reflects it's current power level. 
- As we get closer to Higher Difficulties release, hopefully you all will understand the goal we have here. 

[i]Hunt Trophies[/i]
Hunt Trophies Limitation
- The INFINITE combo of Hunt Trophies has come to an end (sorry Hunters). We'll be experimenting with Hunt Trophies having a firing limit of 3 per turn and evaluate from there. 
You should still be able to get the loop going, just not infinitely!

[i]Arrowhead[/i]
Arrowhead has been moved to Universal Common.
- We've noted that the Soldier lacks Relic Class Commons, having more of them be Dice. This would cause an issue where Arrowhead would appear almost EVERY Relic selection in the early rounds.

[b]Death[/b]
Some minor updates to Death's behavior.
- Death is a little more careful about taking "Fumbles" in earlier rounds and should err on the side of caution and more conservative gameplay.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.5: Steam Achievements, Post Game Summary & More now Live!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, [/p][p][/p][p]We've just put patch 0.1.5 live! As we prepare for the major June update that will introduce the first 2 additional difficulty modes to the game, we've added two of the most requested features. [/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Discord Link:[/u][/b] [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/T9EgWBCV4E"]https://discord.gg/T9EgWBCV4E[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Working with our friends over at 983 Interactive who will be helping us out with community & marketing in the future, we've opened up a Discord they'll be running for you all to talk to us about the game's development, report bugs & give feedback! [/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Steam Achievements[/u][/b] [/p][p]We've turned on the first batch of over 30 achievements for the game! When you log in you might already have a bunch, but all of the new challenge achievements will be there to unlock! Who knows what they might grant in the future... [/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Post Game Summary Screen[/u][/b] [/p][p]The first version of the Post Game Summary has been added! After a run now, you'll see a screen that displays a whole host of stats for you regarding how your run went. This is only the first iteration of the screen, so we'll be listening for feedback and requests as to what you'd like to see on it. A Detailed Relic Summary is in the works already, it's a lot of data to build![/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Dice Display[/u][/b] [/p][p]Dice now display on (well, above) the relic bar! this means you can read your dice while selecting new ones, or just hover them at any point for a refresher on what you have. [/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Steam Deck & Controllers[/u][/b] [/p][p]A few minor tweaks have been made, the biggest of which should allow Steam Decks to maintain a consistent 60fps at stable performance should they choose to. We still recommend using the Deck's built in FPS limiter at 30-40, purely for battery reasons, but it can now handle 60 if you desire! [/p][p][/p][p]There's the usual slew of bug fixes as well, the most prevalent of which is the main menu now handles swapping between controller & mouse and keyboard correctly. [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for all your help with bug reports and feedback so far, and good luck achievement hunting! [/p][p][/p][p]Sea Glass[/p]

notes.title: Update: Fixes, Optimisations & Controller Support
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Ahead of our large June update that will introduce the first two "difficulty levels" above the base game, we've cleaned up some issues and optimised some controller inputs. If you have a controller (Steam Deck included) that you play with, please let us know any issues you find! 

Due to how we've built the game to handle swapping between imports like mouse/touch/gamepad, you may have to tap A to set your focus to the Dice occasionally on Controller.

Bug FIxes:

- Rebuilt how Bronze Pickaxe works on the backend generally, which has cleaned up a few bugs related to it

- Controller input glyphs will now correctly show/hide consistently when input swaps

- Tooltip display is more consistent across resolutions and inputs

- The bowl's invisible bounds have been refactored, meaning it's now even more impressive if you manage to get a Dice to land on the table outside the bowl, we haven't managed in testing yet!

- Some people weren't always getting newly added Dice saved to their game, this should not happen anymore.

As always thank you for your help in developing the game! Please let us know any issues that arise in the bug reports forum.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.4 Live! New Relics, New Lighting. Optimisation & More!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Welcome to the first new content patch of Early Access!

We've added a total of 9 new Relics & Dice to the game for you all to go experiment with and break. A few have been added to the basic pool, and rather than spoil them here, you'll encounter the rest through playing with Death!

The other major update is we finally crushed a long standing bug that affected how we could render the game. We've rebuilt our lighting & processing and you'll notice a much richer contrast tone to the game now, as well as what should be significant performance improvements, especially on mid-low end hardware.

[u][b]Full Changelist[/b][/u]

New Relics:

- Added 7 new Relics and 2 new Dice to the game: Nautilus Anchor, Razors Edge, Herbal Remedy, Fool's Gold, Mirror of Meeral, Hunt Trophies, Writing Lily, as well as Onyx & Sapphire Ring have been added.

New Music:

- You'll now encounter a new music track when the game with Death is reaching a tense stage!

New Rendering & Lighting:

- The entire rendering of the game has been updated, this should hugely improve performance as well as look better! Let us know what you think in the comments and Discussion Hub

Bug Fixes:

- While we imagine new relics will bring new bugs, we also took care of quite a few in this Patch. Pomander, certain VFX and hitboxes have all been fixed.

- Basilisk Statuette is more clear about what you can freeze, and looks a bit less uh... well... like it did.

Thanks for helping us this early in EA and for the incredible reception! If you haven't yet please leave us a Steam Review as they help out enormously and your feedback is always appreciated.

Thanks,

Merchant

notes.title: 2x Game Speed & Fixes now Live!
notes.content:
NEW

Turbo Mode - in the Settings you'll find a "2x Game Speed" option, for those of us who want to lose to Death forging Torn Banner in the fastest way possible! Using it will speed up all rolls, effects and other animations.

Settings Page - The settings page got a bit of a facelift. Go check out the new art for it. There's more to come, but we wanted to put an early version in game to replace the old placeholder menu.

BALANCE

- Last Stand now Reinforces 1, down by 3. 

We're not really keen on nerfing things when it can be avoided, but the unintended near-infinite loop that Last Stand provided when combined with Glimmal Ring was a bit too much. 

Coupled with the fact Last Stand has some of the best natural faces (all even, high value) in game, it was performing a little ridiculously. Still good with Glimmal, and still excellent faces.

BUGS

- Current relics should now display tooltips properly prioritized on screen. They'll no longer be blocked by Dice.

- Bank Box corrected to no longer block dice selections.

- Volume Sliders should stop muting the game and will correctly remember their settings.

- Death's Mercy now correctly only reduces Poison stacks when DEATH takes Poison damage.

- Tooltips have been updated to not reference targeting Death on Relics that he can forge.

- Healer activations of her cauldron now fire in the correct order.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: Fixed Dice Tooltip would get stuck on screen for subsequent relic selections, causing the player to be unable to select relics and continue.

Controller Support added!

Relic/Dice Refusal

No Dice

Sounds

notes.title: Hotfix Live
notes.content: Addressing a Golden Shackle bug

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2 is now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This patch is largely a functionality based one. [b]Thank you all for your invaluable help finding bugs and reporting them, as well as for the amazing reception![/b] We will be dedicating ourselves to fixing as many existing issues as possible in the short term, so thank you for your patience.

[b]Balancing Changes:[/b]

- Bronze Pickaxe was maybe a little TOO good at unearthing Relics. It's now a little less likely to, but a little more likely to find you consumable items.

- Healer's Cauldron will now reset between rounds. This was actually a bug technically, but it impacts her strategy greatly.

- Healer & Soldier have had their base health adjusted. Soldier will now be a little more resilient than he previously was.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

- King's Guard had a 3 that was reporting as a 2. This is now fixed!

- Draupnir was causing all sorts of mischief and interrupting other rings effects and sometimes even stealing them to be it's own. We have had a severe chat with Draupnir and it should behave much better now.

- Death's Mercy could double-remove Poison as well as a few other edge case errors. These should be resolved in this update.

- If you managed to get so many relics they reached the bank button, their UI element could render you incapable of clicking Bank. This is now fixed.

- Very rarely, you could manage to get duplicate Dialogues early on in the game if it was one of your first runs. This should be fixed now.

- Dice hover tooltips will no longer awkwardly remain on screen after the end of a Turn.

- Golden Shackle will no longer insist on reminding you that you've broken it every Turn after it's actually broken. 

- Dice of Many Faces would soft lock the game if you rolled it as the only Dice and it landed on a Blank Face. This has been fixed in tonight's update. It will also now show the value of the face you selected afterwards.

- Pauper's Cup now correctly retains it's stacks over Turns.

- Hover tooltips should now be a little more responsive and contextually flip the side they display on to account for screen space.

- Quite a few minor tooltip, UI & miscellaneous errors.

- Fairweather Friend returning every roll bug is not in this patch, we will likely address that in the coming days however!

That's all for tonight's update, we hope this addresses some of the issues encountered thus far!

notes.title: Death Perfect Bank Hotfix

notes.title: Death Health Hotfix

notes.title: Hotfix Live!

Fixed a few minor bugs with dialogues

Temporarily disabled retry button due to an issue with unlocks being blocked when you used it that will take us a little longer to resolve.

notes.title: Alpha Demo Update & The Future
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First off, thank you to everyone who played the Demo. Your help in finding pesky bugs in the core functionality, and providing incredible feedback and encouragement has genuinely been priceless to us. 

You've not only helped us clarify the future stages of development, but also your kind words (and seriously some [i]wild[/i] playtimes) on the Demo have been an amazing reinforcement to us.

With that said, development continues. The Next Fest Alpha no longer represents the game in an accurate manner, we've already added so much in the 3 weeks since! [b]We'll be taking down the current Alpha Demo this coming week[/b]. This is so we can properly market and represent the game when necessary, as this current version was never meant to function as a long term Demo.

The good news is that we're aiming to head to Early Access within the next 2 months, so that we can continue to develop the game alongside you all. We'll be talking a lot more about this in the future - but just to let you know you won't be without the game for long! At some point there will also be an updated Demo, more representative of our fulfilled vision for Dice With Death.

Once more, thank you. There's still time to get a few games in on the Alpha should you wish to, and we'll speak more soon!

notes.title: HUGE Demo Update Live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

There's a lot to cover in this update so we'll keep it brief!

- The main piece of feedback we've heard is that you wish there was more to play in the demo... that's pretty good feedback. So we added more! We've implemented Round 3 to be live in the Demo, Death brings a pretty nasty trick to the game, so good luck!

- Added a simple Quality toggle to help those on older hardware, setting the game to low will disable advanced lighting and lower stress on hardware significantly.

- We've added one of the core mechanics to the demo, to coincidence with the introduction of Round 3. Relics chosen now also increase your base health! This adds an additional strategy in choosing your Relic lineup to get the victory!

- Re-balancing of Death's health based on round completion stats & to account for the base health on Relics.

Time to return to the afterlife and see if you can best Death's new challenge!

Cheers,

Sea Glass

notes.title: New Relics & Next Fest Demo Update Now Live!
notes.content:
We've put live our initial build for Next Fest! It includes a bunch of bug fixes, as well as some new Relics and Quality of Life features!

- Two new Relics: Heart Locket & Bone Arrowhead! 

- The Bank is now built into the table!

- A bunch of minor bug fixes.

Enjoy the build, share the game, and let us know how you find it!

notes.title: Optimisation Patch Now Live
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Thanks for the incredible feedback & bug reports so far. You have all really helped us get the game ready for Next Fest!

We're pleased to say we've just released our first "optimised" build. Previously we had been moving so fast that we hadn't taken time to properly implement some resource saving measures. You should notice the game using up to 50% less resources now. 

This will naturally be more noticeable on older machines, and it should run pretty smoothly on most things now!

In addition to this, we've fixed several bugs including:

- Retry button re-enabled so you no longer have to return to the menu after each run if Death wins.

- Artists Paintbrush now working as intended (no more bonus bonus damage for you sorry!)

- Ruby Ring will no longer cause the Banking UI to show up while picking a Relic if it deals the winning damage to Death.

- Pebbles now trigger as intended, and also had some UI issues resolved.

There's a bunch more minor fixes, and we'll have more improvements coming to the game almost daily for the foreseeable future.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: First Major Demo Patch Released
notes.content:
We have released a sizeable update for the demo addressing some early bugs and user flow issues.

- Many speed optimisations are now in. You should notice time both in rolls and between them being significantly shorter.

- Dice selection issues have been largely resolved with a rework of the selection system. Make sure to let us know any issues you run into with the new one!

- Placeholder VFX have been enabled for all remaining relics, while these don't represent final quality or intent, they should help liven up your rolls in the Alpha a bit!

- Users may encounter an issue with the game not banking the correct amount of dice when selecting 6 dice hands such a Three Pair. Artist's Paintbrush currently deals too much damage in round 2 as well. Both of these bugs technically give the player an unfair advantage, so have fun!

Thanks so much for all your help in playing the demo and submitting feedback so far. The initial response has been amazing.

Cheers,

Sea Glass Games
